dict.string: Adds new themes to Dopamine, alongside the stock ones, each with its own app icon. Pick one in Dopamine → Settings → Theme.

Trollamine, Gold, Lime, Midnight, Frost, Mocha, Neon.
Close Dopamine from the app switcher and reopen it after installing or flipping the switch.
Add your own: put a .plist (same keys as Dopamine's Themes.plist, plus "appIcon" for a square PNG icon) and its images in /var/jb/Library/DopaThemes.
DopaThemes 1.1 from Cobalt.
